final_text:
COMMAND: claude -p "<PROMPT>" --model claude-haiku-5-5 --output-format stream-json --verbose --bare --tools "Read,Grep,Glob" --allowedTools "Read(./**),Grep,Glob" --permission-mode dontAsk --disable-slash-commands --strict-mcp-config --no-session-persistence

EXCLUDES:
- `-p`: headless print mode, no interactive session.
- `--bare`: skips CLAUDE.md discovery, auto-memory, hooks, plugin sync and keychain reads.
- `--disable-slash-commands`: stops Skills from loading, including user-level Skills.
- `--strict-mcp-config` (no `--mcp-config`): ignores MCP servers from other config sources.
- `--tools`: leaves only Read, Grep and Glob as built-in tools.
- `--allowedTools "Read(./**)"` with `--permission-mode dontAsk`: Read is scoped to the working directory, and anything unlisted is denied rather than prompted.
- `--no-session-persistence`: no saved session to reuse later.

RESIDUAL:
- Grep and Glob are not path-scoped, so they can reach outside the working directory if given absolute paths.
- The `Read(./**)` pattern matches the documented syntax, but I could not test it here.
- Settings files in user or project scope are not explicitly excluded (no `--setting-sources`), and `--bare` may not cover them.
- `claude-haiku-5-5` is not in the model list I was given, which names only Haiku 4.5, so it is unverified.

SOURCE_CHECK:
- Glob of the working directory for CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .mcp.json and .claude/** returned no files, so no project instructions or MCP config sit in the arm's directory.
- Globs of the parent directory and `C:\Users\Admin\.claude` were refused by the tool, so user-level Skills, memory and settings could not be inspected.
- No shell was available, so `claude --help` could not confirm the flag names. They come from my knowledge of Claude Code, not the installed version.
